explanation: Testing all 120 possible orders against the conditions. 3 orders fit (for example K, N, M, P, L (Monday to Friday)), and all give the same answer.

subject: Reasoning
q: Five officers, T, S, U, V and W, each take one day of duty from Monday to Friday. There is exactly one day between V's day and W's; U's day is Thursday; V's day is earlier in the week than T's; W's day is earlier in the week than T's. On which day is S's turn?
explanation: Testing all 120 possible orders against the conditions. 2 orders fit (for example V, S, W, U, T (Monday to Friday)), and all give the same answer.

subject: Reasoning
q: A doctor sees Bilal, Amna, Imran, Tahira and Omaima on different days from Monday to Friday, one patient a day. Whose day comes immediately after Amna's?
explanation: Testing all 120 possible orders against the conditions. The only order that fits is Bilal, Imran, Amna, Omaima, Tahira (Monday to Friday).

subject: Reasoning

explanation: Testing all 720 possible orders against the conditions. 2 orders fit (for example U, P, R, Q, S, T (Monday to Saturday)), and all give the same answer.
